description: Spec routes no resource method declares, each with the reason. tests/test_route_coverage.py fails on a route that is neither declared nor listed here, on an entry whose route a method now declares or the spec no longer has, and on an entry with no reason. A reason starting 'not yet implemented' names the issue that will implement the route, so that work shows up as entries removed from this list.
